description_en: Queries the tags attached to resources in Cloud Config
description_zh: 查询配置审计中资源绑定的标签
kebab_example: aliyun config list-tag-resources --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --resource-type ACS::Config::Rule --api-version 2020-09-07 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListTagResources

parameters.help_en: The ID of the region to which the tags belong
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The token to retrieve the next page of results
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en:
The resource type in CloudConfig. Valid values:

`ACS::Config::Rule`: a rule for a single account.

`ACS::Config::AggregateConfigRule`: a rule for multiple accounts.

`ACS::Config::Aggregator`: an account group.

`ACS::Config::CompliancePack`: a compliance package for a single account.

`ACS::Config::AggregateCompliancePack`: a compliance package for multiple accounts
parameters.help_zh:
配置审计的资源类型。取值：
`ACS::Config::Rule`：单账号下的规则。
`ACS::Config::AggregateConfigRule`：多账号下的规则。
`ACS::Config::Aggregator`：账号组。
`ACS::Config::CompliancePack`：单账号下的合规包。
`ACS::Config::AggregateCompliancePack`：多账号下的合规包
parameters.name: resource_type

parameters.help_en:
The resource ID.

You can query tags for a maximum of 50 resources
parameters.help_zh:
资源ID。

最多支持为50个资源绑定标签
parameters.name: resource_id

fields.help_en:
The tag key of the resource.

You can specify a maximum of 20 tag keys
fields.help_zh:
资源的标签键。

最多支持绑定20个标签键
fields.name: key

fields.help_en:
The tag value of the resource.

You can specify a maximum of 20 tag values
fields.help_zh:
资源的标签值。

最多支持绑定20个标签值
fields.name: value

parameters.help_en:
The tags of the resource.

You can filter resources by a maximum of 20 tags
parameters.help_zh:
资源的标签。

最多支持绑定20个标签
parameters.name: tag

NextToken.description_en:
The token to retrieve the next page of results.

This parameter is empty when there are no more results to return
NextToken.description_zh:
下一个查询开始的Token。

如果为空，则说明无下一页
NextToken.title_en: 下一个查询开始Token，NextToken为空说明没有下一个
NextToken.title_zh: 下一个查询开始Token，NextToken为空说明没有下一个
